acceptanceCriteria: A: finalization action and error categories come from typed observed facts rather than English error-string matching; retained, missing, corrupt, identity-mismatch, cleanup-pending, and unknown cases provide correct safe next actions.

B: one request-scoped observation boundary records every required file and directory candidate dependency, including events and archive candidates, detects replacement/addition/deletion/type drift, and returns unknown after bounded instability.

C: collaboration scenario matrix executes real CLI and MCP paths across summary/full and en/zh-CN/ja, verifies blockers, authorization, unknowns, and action semantics, and proves manual fixture expectations cannot mask endpoint defects.

D: performance traces bind operation, scenario, measurement, runtime identity, phase parentage, and counters to actual boundaries; benchmark separates probes/metadata/processes, uses at least 100 valid warm samples, and reports p50/p95 only with sufficient evidence.

E: each optimization is independently measurable and committable, is retained only when correctness gates pass and the measured bottleneck improves without unacceptable regression, and no unmeasured candidate is presented as a benefit.
All required Rust, matrix, performance, documentation, governance, release, installation, and upgrade checks pass from the reviewed branch; historical bytes remain unchanged.
A new immutable version is discovered after v0.2.90, published from the reviewed merge, and its downloaded artifact passes isolated install and N-1 upgrade acceptance.
The Work Item follows start, preflight, checkpoint, verify, finish, archive, reviewed PR, merge, close, documentation promotion, synchronization, and exact cleanup with current Runtime evidence.
